title: Quality and Release Process for Low-Code Apps
short_desc: A clear, step-by-step process for employees who build their own apps, from idea to release, with quality checks along the way.
problem: Many teams built apps on the Power Platform without a shared way of working. That made quality and IT rules hard to manage.
built: I designed a model that covers requirements, separate test and live environments, testing and release approvals. Then I agreed it with the stakeholders.
result: Teams could keep building quickly while meeting IT's rules.
tech_notes: The model defines each stage from requirements to release: separate development, test and production environments, test steps, and approval gates before release. I agreed the model with several business stakeholders and IT, balancing speed for the app makers against IT's release and compliance rules.
